decision.summary: No temporary offset intervals are confirmed or uncertain within allowed_context [455,579]. The E-component ramp from ~490–544 is monotonic and sustained without a return, and lacks coherent N/U counterparts; it qualifies as a trend (possibly systematic or deformational), not a temporary offset. The later coupled E-upward/U-downward trend begins near 520 but extends beyond the allowed context and also shows no return within [455,579]. No opposing return is observed on any axis for any candidate interval, and no isolated step-like onset/return pair meets the definition of a temporary offset.
